## Summary

Describe the problem, focused scope, and relevant issue. Report suspected vulnerabilities through
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/o-viken/agenticlab/security/advisories/new),
not a public pull request.

## Verification

List commands/checks run and their results, plus any failures or checks not run. Distinguish
fake-model coverage from live-model verification; mark model-dependent behavior as unverified when
appropriate. Do not include credentials, private prompts, workspace contents, or unredacted logs.

## UI Evidence

For UI changes, include sanitized screenshots and desktop/mobile coverage where layout changes.
Otherwise, mark this section not applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the existing architecture and conventions.
- [ ] Relevant tests were added/updated and run, or omissions are explained above.
- [ ] Documentation was updated where needed, and links/commands were checked.
- [ ] No secrets, private workspace content, sensitive captures, or personal data were added.
- [ ] New third-party assets/code have compatible redistribution terms and required attribution, or none were added.
- [ ] Model-dependent changes were verified with a live model or explicitly marked unverified/not applicable.
